description:
Dear Team,

Here’s a quick recap of the MUN CS Society blog activity over the past two months. In **January 2024** we published two pieces: *“Introduction to Quantum Computing”* authored by **Dr. Elena Martinez** (available in the **quantum‑intro** folder) and *“Building a Simple Neural Network in Python”* by **Alex Chen** (found under **nn‑python**). Moving on to **February 2024**, the lineup expanded to three posts: *“Exploring the Ethics of AI”* written by **Prof. Samuel Ortiz** (folder **ai‑ethics**), *“A Guide to Version Control with Git”* by **Priya Singh** (folder **git‑guide**), and *“Deploying Containers with Docker Compose”* contributed by **Michael Liu** (folder **docker‑compose**).
